components.statement: Bjellqvist's pKa values, the 20 amino acids' three-letter codes and the base complements are taken from Biopython 1.88, whose modules are offered under the Biopython License Agreement or the BSD 3-Clause License; both are given below.
components.evidence: server/scripts/gen_biochem_expected.py writes biochemData.json ('_generated' names Biopython 1.88) from Bio.SeqUtils.IsoelectricPoint (positive_pKs, negative_pKs, pKnterminal, pKcterminal) and Bio.Data.IUPACData (protein_letters_1to3, ambiguous_dna/rna_complement). Their headers, from the conda env (biopython-1.88 conda-forge build py312h5cc1888_1) and byte-identical at tag biopython-188 (commit d7e4b8b19399668b09442a5b35765d9186b5f665): IsoelectricPoint.py (sha256 93a0d329…) '# Copyright 2003 Yair Benita.  All rights reserved.' / '# Revisions copyright 2020 by Tianyi Shi.  All rights reserved.'; IUPACData.py (sha256 897fb42f…) '# Copyright 2000 Andrew Dalke.  All rights reserved.'; both '... governed by your choice of the "Biopython License Agreement" or the "BSD 3-Clause License"'. Comment markers '# ' dropped in the copyright lines. LICENSE.rst holds both licences and the BSD holder line (it equals the env's dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.rst, whose RECORD hash matches). The pKa values cite Bjellqvist et al. 1993 and 1994 (biochemData.json 'citations'): published measurements, no licence of their own.
